boo4.speaker: Mousie
boo4.text: Pfft— you look like you've seen a ghost. Oh wait... it’s just me.

boo5.speaker: Kitty
boo5.text: Could you... return Oyen's bracelet, pretty please?

boo6.speaker: Mousie
boo6.text: Bracelet? Ohhh, you mean that shiny thing I found just lying around~

boo8.speaker: Mousie
boo8.text: Hers, mine— does it matter? It looks way better on me.

boo9.speaker: Kitty
boo9.text: ...I- I can give you something in return?

boo10.speaker: Mousie
boo10.text: Hmmm... bribes already? You must really want it back.

boo11.speaker: Kitty
boo11.text: Please... I just... I don’t like being here...

boo12.speaker: Mousie
boo12.text: Aww, poor kitty scared of a little mouse! What, heard a scary story about me?

boo14.speaker: Mousie
boo14.text: Ha! That’s adorable. Alright, if you want the bracelet...

boo15.speaker: Mousie
boo15.text: Bring me some CHEESE. The stinkier, the better.

boo16.speaker: Mousie
boo16.text: And don’t take too long. I might just ‘lose’ the bracelet by accident~

boo2.speaker: Kitty
boo2.text: AHH!! I mean... No... Not yet...

boo3.speaker: Mousie
boo3.text: YUM! Okay, here is your stupid braclet.

boo7.speaker: Kitty
boo7.text: Oyen said this braclet is her EVERYTHING!

boo9.speaker: Kitty
boo9.text: Don't you even DARE to call it ugly!!

boo10.speaker: Kitty
boo10.text: I'm not afraid of you anymore, and I won't let you bully others!

boo1.speaker: Mousie
boo1.text: Why was she afraid of me......... Am I that ugly?

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Hi, have you seen a mouse?

boo2.speaker: Mangle
boo2.text: A mouse..? That freaky dog, John Daniel, in that ridiculous hat probably saw it. He loves rodents. A little too much maybe.

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Hi, can you give me some cheese?

boo2.speaker: John Daniel
boo2.text: Whaaaaaatttt? Why would I - John Daniel - give you my precious cheese?

boo3.speaker: Kitty
boo3.text: Please! I need to give Mousie some cheese so they return Oyen her braclet!

boo5.speaker: John Daniel
boo5.text: That stupid rat always steals everyone's stuff!

boo7.speaker: John Daniel
boo7.text: Bring me a FUNNY HAT and then I'll share some of my cheese.

boo8.speaker: John Daniel
boo8.text: But only because I hate that braclet-cheese-stealing rat!

boo1.speaker: John Daniel
boo1.text: Have you gotten me a FUNNY HAT?

boo2.speaker: John Daniel
boo2.text: Alright, here is some of my cheese.........

boo1.speaker: John Daniel
boo1.text: That stupid rat... Always bullying others...........

boo1.speaker: Assyla
boo1.text: Oh, ignore me... I have no one to dance with...........

boo2.speaker: Kitty
boo2.text: Hey, could I borrow your hat?

boo4.speaker: Assyla
boo4.text: Only the absolute DANCE CHAMPION is worthy of this beautiful, majestic, whimsical hat!

boo5.speaker: Kitty
boo5.text: ...And I guess YOU are the dance champion...

boo7.speaker: Assyla
boo7.text: Have been for five years in a row!

boo8.speaker: Assyla
boo8.text: I'm so good at dancing that no one wants to compete with me anymore! :(

boo2.speaker: Assyla
boo2.text: Okay, since I'm SO kind, I'll let you try again.

boo7.speaker: Assyla
boo7.text: NOW MOUSIE WILL MAKE FUN OF ME AGAIN!!!

boo9.speaker: Assyla
boo9.text: Yes!! They were making fun of me for not knowing how to dance!

boo10.speaker: Assyla
boo10.text: So I decided to learn and become the very best!

boo11.speaker: Assyla
boo11.text: But now...... I know I'm not the best...........

boo13.speaker: Kitty
boo13.text: I didn't even want your hat, but...

boo15.speaker: Kitty
boo15.text: I promised John Daniel to bring him your hat.

boo16.speaker: Assyla
boo16.text: Why would you promise something like that to that nasty dog???!!?!?!?!?

boo17.speaker: Kitty
boo17.text: So he could give me some cheese for Mousie!

boo21.speaker: Assyla
boo21.text: But Oyen is my friend, so I'll help you.

boo23.speaker: Kitty
boo23.text: Thank you so much!!! Let's dance again later!

boo1.speaker: Assyla
boo1.text: ...that stupid mouse, I'll have my revenge one day..........

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Hi, I heard you knew where a mouse is.

boo2.speaker: Chica
boo2.text: Oh.. I did see a mouse. He liked my cheese, but I think he scurried off to N’s direction near the end of that road…

boo2.speaker: Nerd
boo2.text: Sure, but you have to play a game.

boo3.speaker: Nerd
boo3.text: I'll give you a sequence of colours and you have to memorize it.

boo1.speaker: Nerd
boo1.text: You chose the wrong color! Better luck next time!

boo1.speaker: Nerd
boo1.text: Thanks for playing with me! Heres my bowtie.

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Uh, I am looking for a mouse with a bracelet. Is that your mouse? Perchance?

boo2.speaker: N
boo2.text: Oh word. Yeah I can hook you up with me mousie. No worries dawg.

MouseAppear.speaker: Mousie
MouseAppear.text: You can’t just say “perchance”. Here's the bracelet.

AfterMouseGivesBracelet.speaker: Kitty
AfterMouseGivesBracelet.text: Oh, thank you mousie... Please do not eat me.

MouseBye.speaker: Mousie
MouseBye.text: HAHA, nice joke. We will see you around then, bye!

boo3.speaker: Oyen
boo3.text: THE STUPID MOUSE STOLE MY BRACELET!!!

boo7.speaker: Oyen
boo7.text: This bracelet was my magnum opus!

boo11.speaker: Oyen
boo11.text: My name is Oyen by the way!

boo12.speaker: Kitty
boo12.text: I'm Kitty, nice to meet you!

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Hey, I got your bracelet back..

boo2.speaker: Oyen
boo2.text: Really? You got it back? Thank you, thank you! This means a lot to me. My name is Oyen, by the way. Let us be friends!

boo3.speaker: Kitty
boo3.text: Friends… ? Sure! I'm Kitty. But I have to find a way back home to Kitty Town… Do you happen to know how?

boo4.speaker: Oyen
boo4.text: Oh… you live in Kitty-Town across that river? … … …

boo5.speaker: Kitty
boo5.text: Yeah, can you take me there?

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: Hiiiiiii, do you know how I can go back to the Kitty City?

boo2.text: To the other side? I wish we knew!

boo1.text: Poor kitten, I hope she'll be fine!

boo2.text: Yeahhhhhhh, it's always hard to accept!
